Guidance & outlook: The segment contributed around 37% to our revenues in Q1 FY27.
Revenue from the segment increased to INR 53 crores in Q1 FY27 from INR 30 crores in Q 4 FY26.
As a result, our GDV under execution increased to INR 1,800 plus crores, compared to INR 1,250 crore at the year-end Q4 FY26, providing strong revenue visibility over the coming years.
Growth & demand: During the quarter, we secured a new DaaS mandate worth INR 650 crores from a leading developer in Mumbai, further strengthening our project pipeline.
For the quarter under review, the revenue from operations stood at INR 291 crores, registering a strong growth of 37% YoY.
EBITDA for the quarter grew 68 % YoY to INR 31 crores, with EBITDA margins improving by 191 basis points YoY to 10.49%.
Margins & costs: We delivered approximately 8.65 lakh metric tons of construction materials during Q1 FY27, supported by increasing utilization across our manufacturing partnerships and continued customer demand.
Their combined share moved from about 46% to 63% as of Q1 FY27, and that's the main lever behind the EBITDA margin expanding.
So since that business have, like, 50 -55% EBITDA margin kind of thing.
Capex & expansion: Under this segment, we secure production capacity through exclusive long- term partnerships with manufacturing plants without owning the assets ourselves.

Ronak Morbia So whatever deposits we had given to lock in the multi -year capacity, which was about 90 lakh metric tons annually, we will be recycling those deposits, not adding more deposits, but using those same deposits to add more capacity.
And we look to add about 2- 3 million annual capacity this year , in the next two quarters.
Balance sheet & cash: Our net working capital days further improved to 56 days, compared to 66 days as of March 2026, demonstrating our continued focus on efficient working capital management.
Our balance sheet remains robust with net debt -to-equity at just 0.02 x, providing ample financial flexibility to support the future growth.
I mean, if you look at the receivables also, at the end of Q1 last year, YoY comparison, we've grown approximately 37% in terms of revenue, but the receivables grew just 15%.
Risks & challenges: Aris focused on solving these challenges by building an integrated execution and procurement network powered by technology, data intelligence , and disciplined operations.
So, my guess would be that chances of credit losses would decline.
We get the benefits, and we reap the benefits where you can see that the DaaS model, the EBITDA levels are at 60-65% without any kind of real estate risk that we take.

guidance.t: And given that the revenue would be growing 35- 40%, DaaS would be following the same range.
